turns.text: Hi there! Have you got any plans for the weekend?
Yes, I will go to my grandmother house and we will cooking together.

That sounds lovely! What are you going to cook?
💡 "my grandmother's house" (iyelik için 's gerekir) ve "we will cook" (will'den sonra fiil yalın hâlde olur).
We are going to cook mantı. It is a Turkish food with meat.
Oh, I love mantı! Is it hard to make?
Yes, very hard. It takes three hours.
Wow, three hours! Your grandma must be really patient. Who usually does the folding?
So, what are you reading at the moment?
I am reading a novel of Orhan Pamuk. I am reading it since two weeks.

Nice! Which one is it, and are you enjoying it so far?
💡 "a novel by Orhan Pamuk" (yazar "by" ile söylenir) ve "I've been reading it for two weeks" (süre "for" ile, süregelen eylem Present Perfect Continuous ile).
It is My Name is Red. Yes, I enjoy it but some parts are boring.
That's fair. Long descriptions can slow things down. What keeps you reading, the story or the characters?
Hikaye çok gizemli, katil kim merak ediyorum.

A murder mystery set in the past, that's a great hook! Do you have any guesses yet?
💡 İngilizcesi: "The story is very mysterious; I'm curious about who the killer is."
I heard you've got a job interview soon. How are you feeling about it?
I am a bit nervous. The interview is on Monday and I didn't prepared yet.

That's totally normal, and Monday still gives you time. What kind of job is it?
💡 "I haven't prepared yet" ("yet" ile Present Perfect kullanılır; "didn't" sonrası fiil yalın olur).
It is a marketing job in a big company.
Exciting! Have you thought about what they might ask you?
Maybe they will ask about my experience. I worked two years in a small agency.

That's useful experience. You could prepare one or two examples of campaigns you're proud of. Is there one that comes to mind?
💡 "I worked for two years at a small agency" (süre "for" ile; iş yeri için genellikle "at").
Good evening! Are you ready to order?
Yes. I want a chicken soup and one salad, please.

Of course. Would you like something to drink with that?
💡 Restoranda "I'd like a chicken soup and a salad, please" daha kibar duyulur.
A glass of water, please. Is the salad big?
It's a medium size, so it's nice as a side. Would you like any bread?
No, thank you. How much is it?
That's twelve pounds altogether. Will you pay by card or in cash?
Be honest: how many hours a day do you think you spend on your phone?
Probably too much, around five hours. Most of the time I am scrolling social medias.

Five hours is pretty common these days, to be fair. Do you ever feel it's affecting your focus?
💡 "social media" sayılamaz bir isim gibi kullanılır; çoğul eki almaz.
Yes, definitely. When I read a book, I can't concentrate more than ten minutes.

That's frustrating, especially when you actually want to read. Have you tried anything to cut down, like app limits?
💡 "I can't concentrate for more than ten minutes" (süre "for" ile).
I tried, but I always close the limit after one day.

Ha, I know that feeling! Maybe leaving the phone in another room while you read would work better. Would you give it a try?
💡 "I always turn off the limit" ("close" yerine ayarlar için "turn off" denir).
Have you ever travelled abroad?
Yes, I have been in Italy last summer. It was amazing.

Italy in summer, how lovely! Which cities did you visit?
💡 "I went to Italy last summer" ("last summer" bitmiş bir zamandır; Present Perfect değil Simple Past kullanılır).
Rome and Florence. Florence was my favourite because the buildings are very beautiful.
Florence really is stunning. Did you get a chance to try any local food there?
